snippet.title: Boar Farm - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the Boar here - https://forty-six.itch.io/boarfarm
You embark on a road trip to visit a new mountain range that opened recently, but your truck suddenly runs out of gas... now, you find yourself in the abandoned ghost town of Boar Farm.
Boar Farm is a 3D semi-horror game inspired by creepypastas and it's predecessor, skebalious.exe. It has multiple endings, which you access by obtaining clues and putting the pieces together.
